pages.speaker: npc
lines: Hiya! Oh, you're a Trainer! That means you're using Pokémon Boxes!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I love meeting end users! Oh, what's up? Why that astonished look? Oh, right, sorry!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: There I go running my mouth again! My name's Bebe! You know the PC Pokémon Boxes?

pages.speaker: npc
lines: I'm the system administrator! I know this is out of the blue, but do you want a Pokémon named Eevee?

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Here you go! That Eevee, I got it from a good friend in Johto who has a whole lot of them. Who knows how many Eevee he's raised over the years. Sorry, that doesn't mean anything to you. Please, be good to it! My buddy Bill developed the basic Pokémon Box storage system. I tinkered with it here and there to make it easier to use.
